literal: having done, protection not providing base people's mean friendship, than attaining not attaining (is) good.
translation: It is better not to attain, rather than to attain, the mean friendship of base people who offer no protection even when befriended.
modern: நட்பு செய்தாலும் பாதுகாப்புத் தராத சிறியவர்களின் தீய நட்பைப் பெறுவதை விடப் பெறாமல் இருப்பதே நல்லது.
explanation: This couplet warns against befriending base people who are unreliable. The word 'ஏமம்' means protection or security, which is the core purpose of true friendship. 'சாரா' indicates their failure to provide this support even after a friendship is formed ('செய்து'). Therefore, the poet concludes that it is far better never to attain ('எய்தாமை') such a mean friendship ('புன்கேண்மை') than to attain it ('எய்தலின்').
